name: Horse Master
prerequisites: Expert trainer class feature (Advanced Player’s Guide 33), Ride 6 ranks
benefit: Use your character level to determine your effective druid level for determining the powers and abilities of your mount.
normal:
You use your cavalier level to determine your effective druid level for determining the powers and abilities of your mount.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Pathfinder Unchained pg. 122
You can spend 5 stamina points to grant your mount a number of temporary hit points equal to your character level. These temporary hit points last for 1 minute.
flavor: You blend horsemanship skills from disparate traditions into a seamless mounted combat technique.
